mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC of FEDFUNDS trend on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or the Rank IC of the threshold signal on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and acceleration in nonfarm payrolls indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS accelerates, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom characterized by sustained growth in new housing starts above 1,300,000 units, consumer confidence and spending rise, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC of HOUST > 1300.0 on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC of INDPRO trend on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and consumer spending, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (UNRATE < 4.5%), or the Rank IC of the threshold signal on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPI) and economic growth (GDP) signals a strong economy with potential for corporate profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL and GDPC1 both rise, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle characterized by rising federal funds rates, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates reduce equity valuations and slow economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC of FEDFUNDS trend on SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
